detail: The agent lifecycle needed a verify step as a deterministic edge between decide and handoff. Six mechanisms form a hierarchy from convention (tests pass) through low-effort additions (assembly tracking, tested_by queries) to new tooling (drift detection, checkable constraints). This relocates rigor from 'agents should follow the lifecycle' to 'the system makes failures visible when they don't.' The tested_by relation type already exists in the knowledge graph but was unused — activating it is the highest-leverage change.
summary: Add rigor framework: verify step in agent lifecycle, tested_by traceability, drift detection, checkable constraints
